title: OP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for a single operator object, covering operator lookup shortcuts, parameter collections, storage, tags, children, errors and warnings, flags, cook information, viewer methods, and common OP operations.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to navigate operators, inspect common OP state, or manipulate shared OP-level metadata.
Prefer opex in generated expressions when a missing operator should raise a useful error instead of returning None from op().
Use par for single parameters and parGroup for grouped controls such as transforms, colors, and tuples.
Use storage/store()/fetch() for operator-scoped persistent state, and tags for searchable user labels that findChildren() and OP Find DAT can use.
Use errors(), warnings(), and scriptErrors() for diagnostics before applying a plan or after validating a generated network.
